name: SKINCOS | 04 No-Show e Reativação

parameters.query:
with past as (
  select a.id, a.conversation_id, a.contact_id
  from wa_n8n.appointments a
  where a.end_at < now() - interval '2 hours'
    and a.status in ('agendado','confirmado')
)
insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
select 'no_show', p.contact_id, p.conversation_id, jsonb_build_object('appointment_id', p.id), now()
from past p;

update wa_n8n.appointments
set status = 'no_show', updated_at = now()
where id in (select id from past);

update wa_n8n.conversations
set funnel_status = 'no_show', updated_at = now()
where id in (select conversation_id from past);

select conv.id as conversation_id, c.id as contact_id, c.phone_e164
from wa_n8n.conversations conv
join wa_n8n.contacts c on c.id = conv.contact_id
where conv.funnel_status in ('no_show','cancelado')
  and c.do_not_contact = false
  and not exists (
    select 1 from wa_n8n.events e
    where e.event_type = 'reactivation_sent'
      and e.conversation_id = conv.id
      and e.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
  );

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'reactivation_sent',
  '{{$json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('reason','no_show_or_cancel'),
  now()
);

parameters.bodyParametersJson: ={{ { number: ('' + ($json.phone_e164 || '')).replace(/\D/g, ''), text: 'Podemos reagendar seu atendimento quando for melhor para você. Quer falar com atendente? (Digite ATENDENTE)' } }}
={{ { number: ('' + ($env.N8N_HANDOFF_NOTIFY_NUMBER || '')).replace(/\D/g, ''), text: 'Erro no workflow 04. Verifique execuções.' } }}

description: No-show/cancelado → reativação com respeito a opt-out.
